desc: Read input N, sequences A and B, K, and the K queries (X_k, Y_k).
Sort sequences A and B, and compute their prefix sum arrays to enable O(1) range sum queries.
For each query (X, Y), use binary search to split the sorted prefixes of A and B into "smaller" and "larger" groups relative to each other.
Calculate the total sum for the query by combining the contributions from the "smaller" group (where B > A) and the "larger" group (where A > B) using the precomputed prefix sums.
Print the calculated sum for each of the K queries on a new line.
